summary: Completed frontend testing of IdentityHero V4 redesign on German homepage. All requirements verified successfully at desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x900) viewports.
passed_tests: Eyebrow text 'NeXify AI · Chat it. Automate it.' displays correctly (uppercase via CSS)
Two-line headline with lime accent class 'identity-title-accent' on second line 'die für dich arbeiten.'
Single underlined link 'Unsere Leistungen →' with data-testid='hero-services-link' present
Stage has data-video='off' (no video present, fallback mode active)
All old decorative elements removed: no .identity-aurora, .identity-grid, .identity-particles, .identity-badge, .identity-task-deck, .identity-output, .identity-decision, .identity-route
Dark background with radial gradients and lime accents visible
Note 'Begrüßungsszene · Film folgt in Kürze.' visible in stage
Sound toggle button correctly hidden (only appears when video exists)
No console errors on page load
Responsive layout works at mobile viewport (390x900)
All three characters render on mobile
